evidence.source: NVIDIA Unix legacy GPU support timeframes
evidence.summary: NVIDIA states that Linux 580.x is the last legacy driver series supporting Maxwell, Pascal and Volta GPUs. This confirms the candidate branch family only; it does not establish an exact Guix package, ABI match, redistribution permission or runtime binding.

evidence.source: NVIDIA Linux driver kernel-module installation guide
evidence.summary: NVIDIA documents the proprietary kernel-module flavor as required for Maxwell, Pascal and Volta; open-source NVIDIA kernel modules are limited to Turing and newer. The GTX 1050 Ti Pascal candidate must not be paired with the open kernel-module flavor.

NVIDIA's supported-product list for Linux driver 580.126.09 explicitly includes GeForce GTX 1050 Ti with device ID 1C82. This confirms that this published 580.126.09 release lists the observed GPU ID; it does not prove that the pinned Guix/Nonguix package resolves to this exact release, builds for the selected kernel, loads, or functions on the H170 machine.

notes: Optional opt-in compatibility research only. NVIDIA identifies Linux 580.x as the last Unix driver series supporting Pascal; the Windows driver version 582.66 does not establish a Linux 580.x package or ABI match.
